Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family. Tom liked to play outside, but he did not like to clean up his toys. His mom always told him to clean up, but he never listened.
One day, Tom went outside to play. He saw his friend, Sam, who was also happy. They played together for a while, but then they started to fight. Tom's mom saw them and knew that they needed to clean up, or they would be in trouble. She called Tom and Sam to go home.
When Tom and Sam went to Tom's house, they saw that the door was open. They went inside and saw that Tom's mom was angry. She was not happy. Tom and Sam knew they had to clean up their house. They worked together and made it clean. Tom's mom was happy, and Tom and Sam learned that it is important to clean up after having fun.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her ball in the park. One day, she saw a man playing a game called golf. He was very good at it, and Lucy wanted to learn how to play too.
The man saw Lucy and said, "Hi, little girl! Do you want to learn how to play golf?" Lucy was very happy and said, "Yes, please!" The man smiled and showed her how to hold the golf stick and hit the ball with a stick. Lucy tried her best, but it was hard for her.
Lucy felt frustrated and wanted to give up. The man saw Lucy's face and said, "Don't give up! Keep trying, and you will learn." Lucy tried again, and this time she got it right. She was so happy and thanked the man. The moral of the story is to never give up and always keep trying, even when things are hard.

, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a special journal that she loved very much. Every day, she would draw and write in her journal. One day, she lost her journal and was very sad.
Lily looked for her journal everywhere. She looked under her bed, in her toy box, and even outside. But she could not find it. She felt very sorry that she lost her special journal. That night, Lily prayed that she would find her journal soon.
The next morning, Lily woke up and found her journal under her pillow! She was so happy! She remembered her prayer and knew that if she prayed, she would find her journal again. From that day on, Lily always prayed for her journal, and it never lost again.
